mainDressCode.title: Dress Code
mainDressCode.description: Guests: light pink and light blue — wear either palette or a thoughtful mix so the room feels balanced and bright.

sections.title: Guests
sections.description: We invite you in light pink and light blue — petal pink, shell pink, sky blue, or ice blue all fit beautifully. Pick one as your main look, or blend both in your outfit.
